error.message: Invalid spatial reference. Unknown coordinate system.

knownDeltas: Esri resolves thousands of WKIDs through PE; the engine resolves a curated WKID-to-EPSG map only (ADR-0009) and honestly rejects the rest instead of guessing. The numeric code contract (400) matches; the message text is ours.
name: unknown-wkid
notes: Query with outSR wkid 999999: outside the curated WKID catalogue, so the replay pins the honest 400/invalid.arguments reject.
source: Esri REST docs: Query (Feature Service/Layer) (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/query-feature-service-layer-.htm); outSR edge
